title: oncosiphon glabratus
intro: Oncosiphon glabratus, commonly known as Cancer Bush, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family and is native to South Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Oncosiphon glabratus include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oncosiphon glabratus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
